mapper.update: INSERT /*LGVPAY00025.createEmailEmpPrevious*/ INTO tb_pay_slip_send_n ( payment_yyyymm ,employee_no ,user_email_addr ,creation_user_id ,creation_date ) (SELECT #{payMonth} ,t.employee_no ,t.user_email_addr ,#{applicationUserId} ,SYSDATE FROM tb_pay_slip_send_n t WHERE TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.payment_yyyymm, 'YYYYMM'), 1), 'YYYYMM') = #{payMonth} )

UPDATE /*LGVPAY00025.updateEmailEmp*/ tb_pay_slip_send_n SET user_email_addr = #{emailOutside} , remark_text = #{remark} , last_update_user_id = #{applicationUserId} /* 최종수정사용자아이디 */ , last_update_date = sysdate /* 최종수정일자 */ WHERE payment_yyyymm = #{payMonth} AND employee_no = #{employeeNo}
mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAY00025.retrieveEmployeeInfo */ em.employee_number AS employee_no , em.full_name_english AS employee_name , em.grade AS grade_code ,(SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('IF_VIETNAM_GRADE_TITLE', em.grade_title, NULL, #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) FROM DUAL) as grade_title_name , em.org_name_local AS organization_name , em.grade_type AS emp_category_name , em.job_family||'.'||em.job_group||'.'||em.job_detail AS work_type_name , TO_CHAR(em.date_hire_subsidiary, 'DD/MM/YYYY') as date_hire_subsidiary , TO_CHAR(em.date_retire, 'DD/MM/YYYY') as date_retire FROM emp_master em WHERE em.employee_number = #{employeeNo}

{call lgvpay_upload_pkg.upload_payroll_employee_email(#{errorCode, mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, /* p_errcode */ #{errorMsg , mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, /* p_errbuf */ #{sessionId, mode=IN , jdbcType=NUMERIC, javaType=string}, #{payMonth , mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, /* p_pay_month */ #{applicationUserId, mode=IN , jdbcType=NUMERIC, javaType=string} /* p_application_user_id */ )}

SELECT /* LGVPAY00025.retrieveEmpEmailList */ pcee.payroll_calculation_exec_id , pcee.employee_no AS employee_no , em.full_name_local AS employee_name , tpe.user_email_addr AS email_outside , tpe.remark_text AS remark , em.lastname_eng AS lastname_eng FROM tb_pay_calc_emp_exec_n pcee , tb_pay_slip_send_n tpe , emp_master em WHERE pcee.payroll_calculation_exec_id = #{payrollCalculationExecId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND em.employee_number = pcee.employee_no AND tpe.employee_no = pcee.employee_no AND tpe.payment_yyyymm = #{payMonth} AND exists (select 1 from tb_pay_slip_send_n ps where ps.payment_yyyymm = tpe.payment_yyyymm and (ps.payroll_calculation_exec_id != #{payrollCalculationExecId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} or ps.payroll_calculation_exec_id is null ) )
AND tpe.employee_no = #{employeeNo}
AND (tpe.slip_creation_flag is null or tpe.slip_creation_flag = 'N')
AND (tpe.transfer_flag is null or tpe.transfer_flag = 'N')
AND tpe.employee_no in (select n.employee_no from tb_pay_calc_set_target_per_n n where n.payroll_calculation_set_id = #{calculationSetId} )
ORDER BY tpe.employee_no ASC

SELECT /* LGVPAY00025.retrieveSendEmailInfo */ mc.mail_id , cc.common_code_desc sender_name , cc.code_data2_value as sender , cc.code_data3_value as value3 , cc.code_data4_value as value4 , cc.code_data5_value as value5 , mc.subject_text as subject , mc.mail_detail_content as mail_content from lgcom_common_code_c cc , lgcom_mail_content_n mc WHERE cc.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_MAIL_TEMPLATE_LIST' AND cc.common_code = 'PAYSLIP_SEND_EMAIL_INFO' AND mc.mail_id = TO_NUMBER(cc.CODE_DATA1_VALUE)
